meta.purpose: Toronto finance recruiter + warm-intro + alumni CRM. Track every touchpoint. Referral-driven hiring is ~70% of Director+ movement in Toronto finance — this is not optional infrastructure.

recruiters.coverage: C-suite and senior Director/VP finance roles at Big 6, pensions, asset managers. Works retained mandates — won't return cold emails unless you're a known-good fit.
recruiters.notes: Approach via LinkedIn with a specific story angle — ALM/IRRBB Director at Big 6. Don't cold-email generically. Prioritize partners who list financial services or risk management.
recruiters.next_action: Identify 2 Odgers Toronto FS partners on LinkedIn; send personalized InMail Week 1 (mention OSFI E-23 tailwind + specific Director ALM search context).

recruiters.coverage: Similar retained exec search profile. Strong with banks and institutional asset managers.
recruiters.notes: Similar approach as Odgers. Find FS-focused partners via LinkedIn.
recruiters.next_action: Week 1 — LinkedIn InMail to 2 FS partners.

recruiters.coverage: Retained exec search; strong with Big 6 and global asset managers.
recruiters.notes: Third retained firm to approach. Lower priority than Odgers / Korn Ferry for Director-level (tend to work more at VP+/C-suite).

recruiters.coverage: Contingent recruiting; strong pipeline of Director/Senior Manager roles at Big 6, AMs, insurers. High-volume; less retained but broader reach.
recruiters.notes: Contingent = multi-shop; will push your profile to multiple clients. Best first recruiter to register with — fast ramp.
recruiters.next_action: Week 1 — call intake line, 30-min profile conversation, share CV + 2 target role categories.

recruiters.coverage: Contingent; CFA-charterholder-heavy books. Mix of Finance roles at Big 6 and mid-market.
recruiters.notes: Similar to Michael Page — register and stay in contact.

recruiters.coverage: Contingent Finance/Risk roles, contract-to-hire common. Good volume at Senior Manager / Manager level — may be slightly junior for Saber's target.
recruiters.notes: Lower priority — more junior bent, but useful for keeping funnel wide. Don't over-invest.

recruiters.coverage: Toronto-focused financial services headhunting boutique. Strong Big 6 + pension-fund book.
recruiters.notes: Local boutique = tight relationship quality. Deborah Dumaresq and Ed Pitoniak era profile. Register early.

recruiters.coverage: Retained + contingent boutique — financial services + analytics focus. Good pension fund and asset manager coverage.
recruiters.notes: Local firm, often gets the mandate before Odgers/Korn Ferry.

recruiters.coverage: Less financial-services-specific but strong Toronto recruiting network. Second-tier priority.
Retained boutique with a CFA-heavy portfolio. Active in Canadian buy-side and risk.
recruiters.notes: Ask around CFA Toronto Society — they have a reputation.

recruiters.coverage: Quant / analytics / data science recruiting. Relevant for vendor-platform secondary lane (Bloomberg, BlackRock, S&P, MSCI).
recruiters.notes: Strong for quant/data roles in US/Canada.

alumni_warm_intros.name: TO-FILL — Moody's Analytics alumni at Scotia / BMO / RBC / CIBC
alumni_warm_intros.notes: Query LinkedIn: 'Moody's Analytics' alumni currently at each Big 6. Expect 10-30 matches total. Prioritize anyone in Treasury, ALM, Model Risk, or Global Risk Management roles.
alumni_warm_intros.next_action: Week 1 — pull list, send 5-10 personalized messages. Message template: 'Hi [name], I saw we overlapped at Moody's Analytics. I'm exploring the Canadian bank ALM / model risk space ahead of OSFI's E-23 and B-12 deadlines — would you be open to a 20-min coffee? I'd value your perspective on [their company]'s team.'

alumni_warm_intros.name: TO-FILL — Moody's Analytics alumni at BlackRock / Bloomberg / MSCI / S&P
alumni_warm_intros.company_targeted: BlackRock (Aladdin), Bloomberg, MSCI, S&P Global, FactSet, SS&C Algorithmics
alumni_warm_intros.notes: Moody's → vendor-competitor alumni are a dense, actionable network. SS&C Algorithmics in particular should have 50+ ex-Moody's staff.
alumni_warm_intros.next_action: Week 1-2 — pull list, send 10 personalized outreach messages.

alumni_warm_intros.name: TO-FILL — Ortec Finance alumni at HOOPP / OTPP / OMERS / IMCO / Mercer / WTW
alumni_warm_intros.company_targeted: HOOPP, OTPP, OMERS, IMCO, Mercer, WTW, Aon
alumni_warm_intros.notes: Ortec served pension funds directly — some have moved client-side, some to Mercer/WTW. Small network but every intro is high-quality.
alumni_warm_intros.next_action: Week 3 (pension sweep week) — identify 5-8 Ortec alumni, reach out.

alumni_warm_intros.name: TO-FILL — EY FSRM 2021-2022 colleagues
alumni_warm_intros.company_targeted: EY (boomerang), Deloitte FSI, KPMG FRM, PwC FS, Oliver Wyman
alumni_warm_intros.notes: 2021-2022 EY FSRM team — senior managers from Saber's period have either stayed at EY (now at Senior Manager/Director level) or moved to Deloitte/KPMG. The EY boomerang is the most natural consulting pathway.
alumni_warm_intros.next_action: Week 2 — direct reach out to 3 former managers via LinkedIn/email.

alumni_warm_intros.name: TO-FILL — Western MSc Finance + Engineering alumni in Toronto finance
alumni_warm_intros.notes: Full-scholarship MSc cohort — small network, often tight.
alumni_warm_intros.next_action: Week 2 — look up Western MSc Fin alumni list, send 5 messages.

alumni_warm_intros.name: CFA Society Toronto — networking events + members directory
alumni_warm_intros.notes: Active events calendar. Join 1-2 events per month, actively network. Volunteer committee roles (e.g., Career & Mentorship committee) would give visibility.
alumni_warm_intros.next_action: Week 1 — confirm CFA Society membership, register for next 2 events.

outreach_log_schema.description: Append entries matching this shape to outreach_log[] as you send messages.

example_entry.contact_id: odgers-001 or a specific person id
example_entry.message_summary: Introduced self as Director/VP-level ALM/IRRBB candidate with Moody's background; mentioned OSFI E-23 tailwind; asked for 20-min call.

outreach_message_templates.recruiter_initial_linkedin: Hi {{name}}, I'm an ALM/IRRBB practitioner at Moody's Analytics with CFA + dual MSc, currently looking for Director-level moves in Toronto — specifically Big 6 Treasury/ALM, model validation, or a vendor-platform lateral (Aladdin, S&P, MSCI, Bloomberg). OSFI's E-23 and B-12 timelines are driving hiring in my exact lane and I'd value your perspective on where the market is moving. Would you have 20 minutes in the next two weeks?
outreach_message_templates.moodys_alum_bank: Hi {{name}}, I noticed we were both at Moody's Analytics. I've been there ~4 years (buy-side Modelling Services) and am starting to look at the Canadian bank Treasury/ALM space ahead of the OSFI E-23 and B-12 deadlines — which is where a lot of my current work sits. How's [their company]? Would you be open to a 20-minute coffee or video call — I'd value your read on the team and the work.
outreach_message_templates.moodys_alum_vendor: Hi {{name}}, I noticed we were both at Moody's Analytics — I've been on the buy-side Modelling Services side since 2022. I'm exploring vendor-side moves — specifically Client Solutions / Product roles at {{platform}} — and am curious how you've found the transition. Would you have 20 minutes for a call?
outreach_message_templates.ortec_alum_pension: Hi {{name}}, we overlapped at Ortec Finance Canada. I spent ~2.5 years in the ALM/LDI consulting practice before moving to Moody's Analytics in 2022. I'm now exploring Director-level moves into pension-fund ALM teams (HOOPP, OTPP, OMERS, IMCO). Would you have 20 minutes for a call? Your perspective on [their current fund] would be hugely helpful.
outreach_message_templates.ey_alum_boomerang: Hi {{name}}, we worked together at EY FSRM in 2021-2022. I've been at Moody's Analytics since then — building out the buy-side ALM / model governance practitioner side. I'm now exploring a return to consulting at the Senior Manager / Director level. Would you have 20 minutes — I'd love your read on the current FSRM practice's hiring posture and where OSFI E-23 is driving the work.
outreach_message_templates.hiring_manager_cold_linkedin: Hi {{name}}, I saw {{target_company}} is building out {{target_team}} ahead of {{regulatory_hook}}. I'm a {{level}} ALM / model-governance practitioner at Moody's Analytics with CFA + dual MSc and a direct Ortec LDI / EY IFRS 17 background. I've just applied to your {{role_title}} posting — if it's useful to chat in advance of the process I'd value a 20-min call. Happy to share my CV by reply.
outreach_message_templates.followup_d3: Hi {{name}}, following up on my application to the {{role_title}} posting last week. I know these processes take time — wanted to flag my specific experience with {{relevant_hook}} which I thought might be useful context. Happy to answer any questions over a short call.
outreach_message_templates.followup_d14: Hi {{name}}, checking in on the {{role_title}} process — I remain very interested. If there's any additional context helpful to the panel on my sign-off authority at Moody's or my Ortec LDI background, happy to share. Thanks again for your consideration.
outreach_message_templates.post_interview_thankyou: Hi {{name}}, thank you for the time today — I particularly enjoyed our conversation about {{specific_topic_discussed}}. Please let me know if there's anything else useful I can share; I remain very interested in the {{role_title}} opportunity.
